LanguageData.CQFAction_TrapMechanism_Tip: Start, disable, or enable the targeted trap mechanism. Its facing sets the direction.
LanguageData.CQF_TrapDirectionTip: Press Q or E to turn the mechanism before placing it.
LanguageData.CQF_TrapTargetNotThing: The CQF trap action needs a thing as its target.
LanguageData.CQF_TrapTargetMissing: The CQF trap action could not resolve a target.
